definitions.gloss: three days ago; the day before the day before yesterday
definitions.explanation: Refers to the day that is three days prior to today. Less commonly used than おととい (day before yesterday), but understood in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨日|さきおととい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I've had a fever since three days ago.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨日|さきおととい}⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{開|あ}けていない→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I still haven't opened the package that arrived three days ago.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨日|さきおととい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧。
examples.english: Even though I just met my friend three nights ago, I already miss them.

notes:
USAGE:
Part of the Japanese system of relative day names: ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧ (2 days ago) → {一昨昨日|さきおととい} (3 days ago). Less formal and less commonly used than simply saying {三日前|みっかまえ}. Mostly used in casual conversation.
Some speakers say さきおとつい instead of さきおととい. Both are accepted.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧: yesterday
- ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧ / {一昨日|おととい}: day before yesterday
- {一昨昨日|さきおととい}: three days ago
- {明後日|あさって}: day after tomorrow
